added: **Brand-new Homepage** — the post-login screen is now a native dashboard. The QuickSight-backed lobby is gone, replaced by a fixed multi-widget grid that surfaces operational signal the moment you sign in. Faster to first paint, no cloud-only dependency, and built so future widgets plug straight in.
**KPI summary cards** — at-a-glance counts of license servers offline and denied requests, each with a one-click deep link into the underlying view so you can act, not just look.
**License Servers Status** — a health donut breaks your fleet down into Healthy, Pending, and Error states, so a single outage no longer hides behind an aggregate number.
**Top 5 Denied Features and Top 5 Features in Use** — see exactly where users are hitting license ceilings, and where your engineering teams are actually spending the budget, side by side.

**Top 5 Saturated and Top 5 Underutilized License Pools** — two complementary widgets spotlight the pools that are maxed out and the pools sitting idle, so reclaim opportunities stop hiding in custom reports.
**Usage trend and Upcoming expirations & renewals widgets** — track how usage is moving over the selected period and stay ahead of renewal deadlines from the same screen.
**Take the Tour** — a guided walkthrough introduces each Homepage card to first-time users, so new admins know what they are looking at on day one.
**SLM activation gate** — when the underlying SLM is not active, widgets stay hidden and a dedicated lock card explains the next step. No empty dashboards, no confusing 'no data' messages.
improved: **Consistent widget states** — every widget on the Homepage uses the same shell, so skeleton loaders, empty states, and error states look and behave the same way across the board.
**Severity-aware alert bar** — operational alerts surface at the top of the page with clear severity styling, so the critical signal is no longer lost in the noise.
